model_annotation: The image displays two grouped bar charts comparing the percentage of recycled materials for aluminium, copper, and nickel in Germany (left) and the European Union (right) for the years 2021, 2022, and 2023. The vertical axis represents the percentage (%) of recycled materials, ranging from 0 to 30, while the horizontal axis lists the three materials. Each material category has three bars, colored blue for 2021, purple for 2022, and grey for 2023. In Germany, the recycling rate for nickel was highest, at 25.1% in 2021, 24.7% in 2022, and 11.4% in 2023. For copper, the rates were 8.3%, 11.3%, and 2.2%, and for aluminium, they were 3.6%, 2.7%, and 1.0%. In the EU, the recycling rate for nickel was 24.3% in 2021, 23.3% in 2022, and 14.6% in 2023. For copper, the rates were 4.4%, 5.1%, and 1.3%, and for aluminium, they were 3.2%, 2.8%, and 1.7%. The data indicates that nickel has the highest recycling rates in both regions, with a notable decrease in 2023 for both Germany and the EU.
